title: I Reported the Hallway Treadmill With the Serial on the No-Storage Sign

parts.text: I walked the third-floor hall at 7:19 p.m. and a numbered treadmill blocked the no-storage sign. Neighbor Bram said cardio was community. I was thirty-six, tenant, holding a bylaws PDF that listed clear egress. I photographed the serial, the sign, and the blocked exit light. Then I reported the serial to the portal. At 7:27 the portal pinged Bram a fine. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. Bram rolled it back inside. Policy now has a second line: HALLWAYS ARE NOT GYMS. I keep the still. The hall finally looks like an exit, not a studio.
